findings.shot: geometry-only backdrop:ash; actual WebKit soak requires per-object confirmation
findings.problem: 現行の背景地面だけで723,456三角形を生成する。628枚の40.269824m平板を各軸24分割し、392,500頂点・25,951,472 bytesの属性とindex配列を持つ。通常可視三角形30万の予算を、この1物体だけで上回りうる。
findings.why: 三角形を減らすべき対象を絞らず描画品質全体を落とすと、コンセプトの視覚要件まで損なう。影を持たず法線と頂点色が一定の地面が大部分を占めるため、品質に必要な分割かを先に検証する価値がある。
evidence: src/world/city.js _buildBackdrop lines 957-984: ground plane(...,true,1), one merged ash mesh, no cast/receive shadows.
src/world/geom.js plane lines 157-181: segment limit24, two triangles per cell, no adaptive LOD.
Node production geometry construction independently reproduced by refute_backdrop; experiment outputs below.
city.updateVisibility only visits chunkGroups; backdrop belongs directly to city.root and is not distance-filtered with detailed chunks.
findings.hypothesis: この巨大な一体メッシュが現行WebKit863,741triの主要因である。境界球は半径700.06mで、部分平板ごとのフラスタム除外がない。ただし現行フレームで実際に提出された内訳は未測定であり、FPS低下の主因とはまだ断定しない。
findings.fix: まず実WebKitでrenderer.renderBufferDirectの前後info差分を物体・target別に4〜8完全フレーム記録し、backdrop:ash寄与を確定する。その結果に基づいて地面だけの不要分割を減らす候補を実装し、同じtier/view/timeで画面の境界・霧・反射を比較する。目標は主scene提出三角形通常300000以下、合算値との照合誤差0。既存実行入口: node tools/test-iphone-webkit.mjs。診断追加が必要で、現在のコマンドは物体内訳をまだ出さない。

recommendedMinimalMeasurement.status: proposed, not implemented or run by this reviewer
recommendedMinimalMeasurement.location: A temporary browser-page observer called from the already permitted Playwright gate; no external service and no public-game instrumentation required.
sequence: After actual new-game/Continue recovery, capture build hash, engine.frame, player and actual camera position/orientation, tier/tierLocked, sceneRT size, post.enabled, post.hdr, tier.bloom, shadowMap.enabled/needsUpdate and available GL vendor/renderer identity. Unknown driver identity remains unknown.

Temporarily wrap renderer.renderBufferDirect, call the original function exactly once with unchanged receiver/arguments, and take deltas of info.render.calls/triangles/points/lines before and after. Aggregate using actual current target and object.name or id, not estimated geometry counts, so groups, instancing and transparent double passes are counted.

Targets: post.sceneRT = scene-color; atmosphere.sun.shadow.map = sun-shadow; post bloomA/B/C/D = named bloom targets; null with post composite material = composite; keep unknown targets in an explicit other bucket.

Capture 4–8 whole frames and compare sum of buckets to renderer.info.render after every completed game.render. Require exact zero discrepancy and restore wrappers in finally on success/error/timeout. No changes to post.enabled, lights, camera logic, tier, scene visibility or render calls in the observation phase.

Collect at least one stationary interval and an actual movement interval across the existing >3m shadow-anchor threshold. Record whether the sun shadow target was actually drawn; do not infer a shadow pass from enabled=true.
If CPU duration is wanted, collect in a separate uninstrumented interval. performance.now around render is CPU submission/traversal plus JS work, not GPU execution or physical-device latency.
expectedDiscriminators: If backdrop:ash accounts for723456 main-scene triangles, RC-01 runtime attribution is confirmed; if it is absent or smaller, investigate the actual largest recorded object instead.

Bloom, if active HDR chain, is six fullscreen triangles plus one composite; disabling bloom cannot explain away723456 geometry triangles. This is a code-supported prediction, pending target-by-target runtime counters.
A high total only on shadow-refresh frames differs from a high stationary main-scene total and should lead to a different intervention.
Many low-triangle alpha layers may dominate software rasterization time despite low triangle count; counters alone do not establish a fragment/GPU bottleneck.

candidateChangeConstraints: The in-memory candidate only changes backdrop ground cell size, retains628 patches, ground extent, normals, colors and non-ground geometry. It reduces the isolated ash count to1256; it is not a committed product change.

Ground patches overlap by6% and UVs restart on each patch. Fewer coplanar primitives can change depth/interpolation rounding at overlap boundaries. Compare actual full-resolution images with frozen camera, time, exposure and effects; inspect roof, boundary ground, street and near-horizon views.
Height fog, wetness and lighting calculations use interpolated world position in fragment shaders; constant vertex inputs support a quality-preserving hypothesis but do not replace actual images.
Do not reduce draw distance, renderer resolution, shadow quality or reference standards just to meet a counter budget. No blind comparison is replaced by these measurements.
